title: UNAUDITED MUTATION SHOULD ROLL BACK
subtitle: Discover Earth. Together. WhatsApp-first GeoAI, GIS, community investigation and research platform for Rwanda.

sections.title: Our Mission & Vision
sections.content: Earth Talk empowers Rwandan citizens, local researchers, and field explorers to document geological specimens, water resources, and terrain features using accessible mobile and WhatsApp technology.

sections.title: Civic Geoscience & Community Science
sections.content: By combining state-of-the-art GeoAI models with community verification, Earth Talk builds open, structured geological datasets for education, environmental monitoring, and sustainable resource understanding.
